primaryTextRead.text: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out against him.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn’t listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
